note: these are FROZEN ANALYTICAL (single-patch) predictions carried forward VERBATIM from artifacts/crack_rebonding_minimal_slope_screen_v1/frozen_predictions.json. They are stored here so Section C/D can compare against them WITHOUT ever substituting them for measured trajectory-integrated A_on/A_off -- the frozen values and the measured values are archived as two separate fields in every downstream analysis output.
no_rescaling_note: no barrier re-inversion, no activation-volume search, no Pi_K rescaling at the new loads -- every kinetics/cohesion parameter is held fixed at its Kmax=18 calibrated value; Pi_K = K_rebond_max/Kmax varies naturally with Kmax
S_h_pred_note: S_h_pred is not defined from single-patch A_on/A_off alone (S_h is a population/rate-ratio quantity from the real engine's cleavage hazard, not the single-patch bonded-fraction model); p_B_star and K_rebond_predicted are the frozen prospective diagnostics available for comparison against measured action-weighted K_rebond and measured pre-event p_B in Section C/D.
